fact_text: Roshan Residencia is a 20-storey project on a four-side corner plot at Shahrah-e-Faisal and Shahrah-e-Qaideen in PCHS, Karachi, with five parking floors and two residential towers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: One tower holds four-bedroom flats of about 2,700 sq ft and the other holds three-bedroom flats of about 2,000 sq ft, per the developer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: The developer expected handover in roughly three to four months from the video date, with only the electrical connection and the completion process still pending.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: The developer said bookings for the project were opened in 2022.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: The developer said the balconies use international-standard fittings with 100% laminated glass, and aluminium windows run wall to wall in the flats.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: Each tower has its own lobby and lifts, and the project includes a play area, a gym and a mosque, which the developer said were meant to meet international standards.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: The project is near Karachi's centre, about 5 minutes by car from NMC Hospital and about 10 minutes from Aga Khan and Liaquat National hospitals, per the developer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: The developer said four-bedroom flats were offered at about 12 to 15 million PKR and three-bedroom flats at about 7 to 10 million PKR.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: The developer said earlier Karachi projects he delivered at under PKR 5 crore are quoted at about 9 crore, those at about 2 crore on Shaheed Millat Road at about 7 crore, and others from 5 crore at 7 to 8 crore.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: The developer argued that Karachi property has become expensive because plots are scarce and commercialisation was halted, and he expected prices to rise further.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: Builders bought plots after the government allowed commercialisation and completed the approval steps, but the commercialisation was then reversed, freezing investor money, according to the developer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: In Karachi, a builder needs ABAD membership to build vertically, and ABAD guarantees construction for eligible members, according to the developer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: Drawing approval and the sale NOC are the main approvals stressed, and a completion certificate is required before possession is handed over.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: The developer said about 90 of every 100 buyer complaints are resolved inside ABAD.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)

fact_text: The developer advised new builders to focus on facilitating buyers and delivering on time, arguing that a first good project leads to more projects and a better name.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Roshan Residencia Karachi: Corner Luxury Apartment Review | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-30)
